item.title: KANSAS WILDFIRE AWARENESS WEEK
item.description: This is Kansas Wildfire Awareness Week and, coincidentally, today and tomorrow the state is under some pretty serious conditions that could lead to wildfires. All counties in the KOFO listening area are under a fire weather watch, starting tomorrow afternoon, February 17th, through tomorrow evening. Despite the weekend rains, very low humidity, strong gusty winds up to 45 mph and dry dormant fuels pose a fire danger. You can expect sustained winds at 20 to 30 mph with gusts higher.
